cleavage_agent: Protein samples were digested into peptides by trypsin and then analyzed on LTQ Orbitrap Velos Pro mass spectrometer (Thermo Fisher Scientific).
enrichment_method: pre-washed GFP-Trap_A agarose beads (ChromoTek) was added to pull down target protein complex.
fractionation_method: After running samples on SDS-PAGE gel, the gel for the same lane was cut into five slices.

instrument.evidence: Protein samples were digested into peptides by trypsin and then analyzed on LTQ Orbitrap Velos Pro mass spectrometer (Thermo Fisher Scientific).

labeling: After mass spectrometry, raw files corresponding to five slices from the same lane were merged and analyzed via MaxQuant (v1.6.0.16) using label free quantification (LFQ).
mass_analyzer: inferred: Protein samples were digested into peptides by trypsin and then analyzed on LTQ Orbitrap Velos Pro mass spectrometer (Thermo Fisher Scientific).
